not_allowlisted: This bot is invite-only. Your account is not on the allowlist.
start_body:
First time here? Run /onboarding to build your personality profile.
Then /new to start creating content.

/help for all commands.
help: Content Factory Bot Commands /start — Welcome /new — New content session /sessions — List sessions /onboarding — Personality setup /providers — Connect accounts /profile — Your answers /settings — Language /cancel — Cancel flow /help — This message
locale_detected_ru: Continuing in Russian based on your Telegram language.
start_need_onboarding: Run /onboarding to set up your personal profile first.
onboarding_pick_or_type: Tap a number below, or type your own answer in the next message.
onboarding_custom_prompt: Type your answer in a message.
onboarding_complete: Personality profile ready. Link where you publish next.
session_setup_intro: New session — choose destinations (if shown), toggles, then start:
session_send_input: Session #{id} started. Send text, image, or voice.
session_active_exists: You have an active session. Finish or /cancel first.
session_drafting_queued: Queued for worker — drafts will be ready shortly.
draft_custom_saved: Custom draft saved. Choose next action:
session_image_received: Image saved. Send text or voice to continue.
session_voice_received: Voice saved. Send more context or text to run drafts.
session_drafting_timeout: Draft timed out. Check worker is running or retry with USE_WORKER=false.
session_drafting_failed: Draft generation failed. Try again or set USE_WORKER=false.
providers_intro: Connect where this bot can publish for you.
providers_setup_required: Link at least one channel before /new.
providers_need_oauth_env: Set PUBLIC_BASE_URL and OAUTH_STATE_SECRET for Instagram/LinkedIn links.
providers_help: Instagram / LinkedIn: tap Connect. Telegram: link channel below.
providers_skipped: You can link channels anytime with /providers. /new stays blocked until at least one is connected.
providers_tg_forward: Forward any post from your channel here (bot must be admin).
providers_tg_not_admin: Bot must be an admin in that channel. Add the bot, then forward again.
providers_oauth_success: {provider} connected. You can use /new when at least one channel is linked.
